Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_Enabled_tool: Allow powered desktop use and framework device validation. Existing application records are retained when disabled. Default: enabled.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_MinesweeperM: Allow the server to reduce boredom and unhappiness during validated active Minesweeper play. Default: enabled. No benefit for idle windows or flag toggling.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_MinesweeperB: Boredom points removed per completed active-play interval. Default: 2. Range: 0 to 10, step 1. Server authoritative.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_MinesweeperU: Unhappiness points removed per completed active-play interval. Lower unhappiness means greater happiness. Default: 1. Range: 0 to 10, step 1. Server authoritative.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_MinesweeperR: Real seconds of validated active reveal progress required per benefit. Default: 30. Range: 10 to 300, step 1. Resetting never awards a benefit.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_MinesweeperA: Maximum gap between reveal progress events that counts as active play. A longer gap clears accumulated time. Default: 30. Range: 5 to 120, step 1.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_ConnectionsE: Enable visited-PC pairing, public endpoints and connected-PC services. Connections do not grant inventory permissions.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPCFramework_PairingHours: In-game hours before a private pairing invitation expires. Start pairing on one PC, then visit another to connect. Public PCs do not require an invitation.
